notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[p]Hi! Here is another hotfix for RCD:[/p][h3][b]
Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue preventing players from hosting a game after being kicked from a lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mutty collision problems [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved pressure plates functionality on "Ward 13 Asylum" map[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed multiple collision issues on "Ward 13 Asylum"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision problems in "Blackridge Basement" map[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminated ladder step duplication glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected demon death behavior after final hunt sequence[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented minor adjustments to "Hollow Pines Residence" layout[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera item functionality - now precisely captures paranormal objects[/p][/*][*][p]Hanging bodies and blood effects now properly register as paranormal objects[/p][/*][*][p]Revised electrical panel mechanics - now requires all switches to be activated[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved rare bug affecting first code puzzle in "Ward 13 Asylum"[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Updates:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed medkit requirement for reviving teammates (medkits fully removed from game)[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced colored crosshair indicators for interactive object that are required to complete the mission[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Close" option to mission results screen[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented "Skip" button for mission results screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added looping siren sound effect to "Ward 13 Asylum"
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for support![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content: [h3]Hi! Here is another hotfix for RCD! [/h3][h3][b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed demon being able to hunt after death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Leave Game" button not working in singleplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players disappearing after returning to lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not being able to host a game after playing in singleplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objective not progressing after selecting a different language.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed saved settings not loading properly.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Updates:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]"Brightness Scale"[/b] option in the video settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]"Player List"[/b] with the ability to kick players during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Voice chat has been brought back as an experimental feature; it is not expected to function properly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[p]Hi! YBT team here with a new hotfix![/p][p]This update addresses several critical issues and improves overall stability. Below are the full patch notes:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p]- Fixed demon collision issues  [/p][p]- Fixed demon being unable to kill a player more than once  [/p][p]- Fixed Camera Item not updating objective progress when photographing the demon  [/p][p]- Fixed spectator camera glitches  [/p][p]- Adjusted demon spawn location on the first map  [/p][p][b]Multiplayer & Lobbies[/b][/p][p]- Fixed "friends-only" lobby type (replaced with functional "invite-only")  [/p][p]- Fixed public 4-player lobbies not appearing in the server browser  [/p][p]- Fixed joining session issues[/p][p]- Fixed ping display in the server browser  [/p][p]- Fixed return-to-lobby failure when all players die  [/p][p][b]UI & Localization[/b][/p][p]- Fixed lost focus when opening the options menu with ESC  [/p][p]- Fixed font size clipping and objective name stretching  [/p][p]- Fixed reward counter inaccuracies  [/p][p]- Updated lobby invite system (old button removed, now uses friendlist interface)  [/p][p]- Added "Join Session" notification when accepting Steam invite or connecting to a public session[/p][p]- Minor translation improvements  [/p][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][p]- Fixed demon jumpscare sound[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Updates & Changes:[/b][/h3][p]- Voice chat is temporarily disabled for engine updates (will return in a future patch).  [/p][p]- All maps are now unlocked from Level 1[/p][p]- Russian language support has been removed.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Known Issues:[/h3][p]- Voice chat will remain disabled until stability improvements are complete.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you to all our early supporters![/b][/p][p]Special thank you to Kartaviy_Bober for streaming RCD and reporting bugs to us.

If you find any bugs in the game, address them in our Discord server.[/p]
